label: Из
description: Source and exit sentences that teach coming out of places, materials, and origins.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Source/origin. 'Из дома' takes the genitive and marks the place left behind. The verb 'вышел' shows completed exit. Contrasts with 'в дом'.

missions.phrase: Я медленно иду из дома на работу.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Motion away from a source. 'Иду' is on-foot motion; 'из дома' in the genitive marks departure from the house. Core contrast with 'я иду в дом'.
Strategic focus: Origin of a person. 'Из города' in the genitive states where he is from. Useful for describing background and hometown when meeting someone.
Strategic focus: Arrival from a source. 'Приехал' is vehicle-based motion; 'из города' in the genitive marks the source. A practical travel pattern.

missions.phrase: Вода вылилась из стакана на стол.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Something coming from a container. 'Из стакана' in the genitive marks the source container. Concrete and easy to picture; source versus location.

missions.phrase: Я медленно пью воду из стакана.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Source plus action. The verb 'пью' is the action; 'из стакана' in the genitive marks where the water comes from. Useful for everyday physical action.
Strategic focus: Exit from a place. 'Вышли' is completed motion out; 'из дома' in the genitive marks the source. One of the most important departure patterns.

missions.phrase: Мы вместе идём из школы домой.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Leaving a location on foot. 'Идём' is plural walking motion; 'из школы' in the genitive marks departure. Contrasts with 'мы идём в школу'.
Strategic focus: Removing an object from a container. 'Достала' is a completed action; 'из сумки' in the genitive marks the source container. Highly practical and vivid.
Strategic focus: Ongoing removal from a pocket. 'Достаю' is present tense; 'из кармана' in the genitive marks the source. A very modern everyday sentence.

missions.phrase: Мы только что пришли из магазина.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Returning from a store. 'Пришли' is plural past motion; 'из магазина' in the genitive marks the source. Strong contrast with 'в магазин'.
Strategic focus: Leaving a room. 'Вышли' marks movement out; 'из комнаты' in the genitive is the source. A very common household and narrative phrase.
Strategic focus: Extracting something from a drawer. 'Вынул' is a strong completed action; 'из ящика' in the genitive marks the source. Vivid and easy to imagine.

missions.phrase: Я слышу странный шум из окна.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Source of sound. 'Из окна' in the genitive marks where the noise comes from; 'слышу' is a perception verb. Source phrases work beyond physical objects.
Strategic focus: Remote action source. 'Из дома' in the genitive marks where the work happens; 'работает' is present tense. Useful in modern remote-work contexts.
Strategic focus: Source of an action. 'Из машины' in the genitive marks the place from which the call happens; 'звоним' is plural present. Natural and useful.

missions.phrase: Он сделал это всё из-за тебя.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Cause source. 'Из-за тебя' takes the genitive and expresses cause or reason; 'сделал' is past tense. A more advanced source-like meaning.

missions.phrase: Я опоздал на работу из-за него.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Cause source with a pronoun. 'Из-за него' in the genitive marks the reason; 'опоздал' is past tense. Shows how cause phrases attach to pronouns.

missions.phrase: Мы пешком идём из центра города.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Departing from a central place. 'Из центра' in the genitive is a clear source phrase; 'идём' is plural motion. Complements 'в центр'.
Strategic focus: Exiting from transport. 'Из поезда' in the genitive marks the source; 'вышли' is the completed motion verb. A very practical travel sentence.
